categories.main_business_segments: By-Health Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the dietary nutritional supplements (VDS) industry, focusing on the production and sales of vitamins, minerals, plant extracts, and other bioactive substances. The company offers a full range of VDS products including tablets, powders, capsules, liquids, and gummies, and has developed multiple specialized brands targeting various health needs such as immunity, women's health, bone health, and vitamins. It also engages in research and development of new functional and heavy-function products, with a strategic focus on anti-aging and precision nutrition.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes strong technological capabilities, including proprietary patented raw materials and formulations, continuous and intelligent manufacturing lines, and stringent quality control systems. It operates the industry's first transparent factory certified for transparency management and CNAS-accredited laboratories. Production methods include self-operated GMP-certified manufacturing centers and selective OEM processing. The company invests in AI-driven quality assurance, RFID logistics, and digital upgrades to enhance production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: By-Health serves a broad consumer base through multiple channels including pharmacies, supermarkets, mother and baby stores, and diverse e-commerce platforms such as Tmall, JD.com, Vipshop, Douyin, and Kuaishou. Its products target consumers seeking nutritional supplements for immunity enhancement, women's health, bone and joint health, and general wellness. The company maintains a strong presence in both domestic Chinese markets and international markets, particularly Australia, Hong Kong, Vietnam, the USA, Malaysia, and Indonesia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant business in Hong Kong and other regions, and Australia. It has subsidiaries and operations in multiple countries including Vietnam, the USA, Malaysia, and Indonesia. The company is expanding its international market strategy and has production bases in China and Australia, including a new Australian production facility to support global operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: By-Health operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the dietary supplement supply chain, focusing on product development, manufacturing, and sales. It sources high-quality raw materials globally and controls production through its own manufacturing facilities and selected OEM partners. The company distributes products through a comprehensive multi-channel sales network, including direct sales and distributor models, serving end consumers directly and through retail partners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include transforming into a strong technology-driven enterprise under the 'Scientific Nutrition' strategy, focusing on proprietary patented raw materials, new functional and heavy-function product development, and cutting-edge research in anti-aging and precision nutrition. It collaborates with top research institutes like the Chinese Academy of Sciences and invests in digital transformation, AI applications, and smart manufacturing. R&D efforts also emphasize clinical research, standard-setting, and product innovation to enhance scientific evidence and differentiation.
categories.revenue_model: By-Health generates revenue primarily through the sale of dietary nutritional supplement products via both direct sales and distributor channels. Sales occur through offline retail outlets such as pharmacies and supermarkets, as well as online e-commerce platforms where the company operates flagship stores and sells through third-party sellers. The company also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies but the core revenue is product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: By-Health holds the leading market position in the Chinese dietary supplement industry with a 9.3% market share as of 2024, maintaining industry leadership. The company faces increasing competition from international brands entering China, large pharmaceutical and food companies, and emerging brands leveraging new media and e-commerce channels. By-Health differentiates itself through strong R&D, patented technologies, quality control, and a broad product and brand portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, By-Health reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 6.84 billion, a 27.3% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 653 million, down 62.6%. The company experienced significant revenue and profit declines due to market competition and slower product upgrades. Total assets stood at RMB 14.28 billion with net assets of RMB 11.05 billion. The company is undergoing strategic adjustments to improve quality and sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: By-Health emphasizes delivering high-quality, scientifically validated nutritional supplements with a focus on consumer health value. Its value proposition centers on 'Scientific Nutrition' with proprietary patented ingredients, rigorous quality control, and transparent manufacturing processes. The company aims to provide differentiated products with innovative functions such as anti-aging and precision nutrition, supported by clinical research and global scientific collaborations. It also focuses on strong brand equity and comprehensive multi-channel consumer engagement to enhance trust and loyalty.
